scope.target: Documented signer path, owner, or recovery route for the historic r3, r4, and r5 LUMINAiRY authorities, with particular attention to the September 7 renewal commit.

ownerThread.title: Complete patron profiles
ownerThread.inspection: Reviewed the accessible owner-history page. It showed the historical temporary worktree reference but no signer location, individual signer, or recovery route. A bounded older-page request failed, so no unreturned turns are claimed as inspected.

renewalCommit.subject: Complete LUMINAiRY teaching chains
renewalCommit.metadataObservation: The commit contains a signing build script and September 7 receipt records; it does not document a private-key filesystem path, secure-store reference, signer identity, or recovery owner.

keyIdentityFindings.evidence: The prior bounded audit receipt records r3 as a public verification identity only. This renewal-commit review found no r3 signer-path, owner, or recovery metadata.
The prior bounded audit receipt records r4 as a public verification identity only. This renewal-commit review found no r4 signer-path, owner, or recovery metadata.

operations/product-stewards/luminairy/cher-dionne-v12-offline-signing-request-2026-09-05.json in the renewal commit identifies r5 in an unsigned receipt and names only an authorized offline editorial signer. Its signature is null and its instruction requires an independently verified P-256 signature; it gives no path, individual owner, or recovery route.

The commit's content/luminairy-editorial-receipts.json identifies r6 as the receipt keyId, while the receipt identifiers are r7-dated. This establishes the signed release's verifier identity and receipt lineage, not access to the r6 private signer or a recovery route.

scriptInterface.finding: The script expects a private-key path via its environment interface and a key ID, but contains no documented value, owner, secure location, or recovery procedure. Environment values were not read.

roleMetadata.finding: The operating specification keeps the private signing authority outside the public candidate and names only role-level building, research, and independent review responsibilities. It does not assign a signer or recovery custodian.

temporaryPath.finding: Absent; no material was read from it.

recoveryDecision.nextAction: Obtain an authorized offline signer or approved recovery-route reference from the authority holder before attempting any new signature. Do not infer one from the r5 unsigned request, the r6 verifier identity, commit authorship, or review roles.
recoveryDecision.exactQuestionIfNeeded: Which authorized offline signer or secure recovery location controls the LUMINAiRY receipt authority needed for this release? Please provide the owner or approved recovery route only; do not paste key material.
